1.explanation:
• Select.js – the main React component; needs to accept new props (e.g. warning, warningText or warn, warnText), add the correct className (e.g. bx--select--warning), and render the WarningFilled16 icon when warning is true.
• Select-story.js – the Storybook stories; needs a new story demonstrating the warning state to match the design spec.
• Select-test.js – unit tests; needs test coverage for the new warning props, verifying classes, icon rendering, and text output.
• index.js – the component entry; may need to export the new warning props in the prop-types API surface.
• Select.mdx – the documentation page; needs to document the new API (warning/warningText), show the design guidelines, and link to the usage.
• ListBoxField.js – the lower-level input field wrapper that renders the list box; must be updated to accept a warning prop and apply a warning modifier class (e.g. bx--list-box--warning) so that the field border/icon spacing can be styled.
• ListBoxPropTypes.js – the shared propTypes for ListBox components; should be extended to include the new warning props and propType definitions.
• select.config.js – the CSS/Sass config for the select component in the core styles; needs to define the warning variant tokens (e.g. token mappings for support-03 color and spacing) so that the compiled Sass will include .bx--select--warning rules matching the design.
1.bug_scenario: The bug request is to add a new “warning” variant to the Select component so that it can render a warning icon, align it correctly (16px from the edge, 8px between icon and menu toggle), and display a warning message beneath the field (using text-01 color). Currently the React <Select> only supports an “invalid” (error) state with invalidText and invalid prop, but no separate warning state. The design spec also shows that in warning mode the SelectField wrapper should receive a warning modifier class, render the WarningFilled16 icon (with fill=“support-03”), and render warningText in place of invalidText styling.

2.explanation:
1. packages/components/src/components/select/select.js and select.config.js:
   - The vanilla Select markup and config need a new ‘bx--select--warning’ modifier class so that the warning styling can be applied at the CSS level.
2. packages/components/src/components/select/select.scss:
   - The component’s stylesheet must be extended to define the warning state colors (support-03 border, icon fills, text-01 for the message) and the proper spacing of the warning icon relative to the arrow.
3. packages/react/src/components/Select/Select.js:
   - The React wrapper must accept a new prop (e.g. `warn` or `warning`) and pass a corresponding `className` down to the underlying ListBox/field as well as a new `warnText` prop for the help message under the field.
4. packages/react/src/components/Select/Select-story.js:
   - The storybook example should demonstrate the new warning state usage, showing how to pass the warn prop, warnText, and renderIcon options.
5. packages/react/src/components/Select/Select-test.js:
   - Unit tests need to cover rendering when `warn` is true: applying the correct class, rendering the warning text, and including the WarningFilled16 icon.
6. packages/react/src/components/Select/Select.mdx:
   - Documentation in MDX must be updated to include the new warning prop in the API table and usage guidelines with example code.
7. packages/react/src/components/ListBox/ListBoxField.js:
   - The underlying ListBoxField component, which renders the input field and icon slot, needs to handle the new warning modifier class and render the icon in the proper position when passed via props.

These files collectively cover the style, markup, logic, docs, and tests necessary to implement and verify the new warning state in both the core component and its React wrapper.
2.bug_scenario: The goal is to add a “warning” visual state to the React Select component so that, in addition to the existing invalid (error) state, a new styling and iconography can be displayed when a warning is needed. The provided screenshots show design specs for a warning state: using the WarningFilled16 icon in Carbon’s support-03 color, placing it at 16px from the right edge of the control and 8px from the dropdown arrow, and rendering a warning message below the field in text-01 color. The existing Select only supports an “invalid” prop with an error style, so we need to implement a new “warn” (or “warning”) prop in both the vanilla component (markup + classnames), the React wrapper, the underlying ListBox field renderer, and update stories, tests, and docs accordingly.
